mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.world_detail_vector_store WHERE metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT('{"worldId":', #{worldId}, '}')::jsonb
DELETE FROM public.chat_history_vector_store WHERE metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"userWorldId":', #{userWorldId}, ',"characterId":', #{characterId}, '}' )::jsonb

DELETE FROM public.group_topic_vector_store vector WHERE vector.metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"userWorldId":', #{userWorldId}, '}' )::jsonb AND (vector.metadata::jsonb ->> 'groupTopicId')::bigint > #{maxGroupTopicId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM group_chat_topic topic JOIN group_conversation conversation ON conversation.id = topic.conversation_id WHERE topic.id = (vector.metadata::jsonb ->> 'groupTopicId')::bigint AND conversation.mode = 'trpg' )
DELETE FROM public.group_topic_vector_store WHERE metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"conversationId":', #{conversationId}, '}' )::jsonb
DELETE FROM public.world_event_vector_store WHERE metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"userWorldId":', #{userWorldId}, '}' )::jsonb

DELETE FROM public.world_event_vector_store vector WHERE vector.metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"userWorldId":', #{userWorldId}, '}' )::jsonb AND (vector.metadata::jsonb ->> 'worldEventLogId')::bigint > #{worldEventLogId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM world_event_log event JOIN group_conversation conversation ON conversation.id = event.conversation_id WHERE event.id = (vector.metadata::jsonb ->> 'worldEventLogId')::bigint AND conversation.mode = 'trpg' )
DELETE FROM public.world_event_vector_store WHERE metadata::jsonb @> CONCAT( '{"userWorldId":', #{userWorldId}, ',"worldEventLogId":', #{worldEventLogId}, '}' )::jsonb

DELETE FROM public.world_event_vector_store vector WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM world_event_log event WHERE event.id = (vector.metadata::jsonb ->> 'worldEventLogId')::bigint AND event.conversation_id = #{conversationId} )
